resources.string: Only the built-in controls. Plug a pad into the OTG port (with an adapter if needed) or pair one over Bluetooth.
Built-in controls. External pads are player 2, 3 and so on, in the order you first press a button on them.
The first external pad you press a button on. The built-in controls are player 2. For playing alone on a bigger pad.
Changes take effect the next time RetroArch starts. If it is open, quit it first (Select + Start twice).

Player 1\'s controller: hold Select for the hotkeys (Start quit, R1/L1 save/load state, X menu).\nAny controller: L1 + R1 + Start + Select or the Xbox / PS / Capture button opens the menu, Start + Select twice quits.
Every controller controls the one player. Buttons are set for the built-in controls and Switch pads (Cross = B). On an Xbox or PlayStation pad, remap them in PPSSPP if you play with it.
Search for a controller in pairing mode
This console has no Bluetooth. Plug a USB Bluetooth dongle into the OTG port to use wireless controllers, or use a USB pad.
Paired, not connected. Turn the controller on, or press A.
To use it again you have to pair it again.
Put the controller into pairing mode

Xbox: hold the small pair button on top until the Xbox button flashes fast.
PlayStation 4 or 5: hold Share (Create) and PS until the light flashes.
Switch Pro: hold the small button on top, next to the USB port.
8BitDo: pick the mode with its switch or Start + a button, then hold Pair for 3 seconds.
Nothing more found. Press A to search again.
Also devices that don\'t say they are controllers
Pairing… If a question appears, choose Pair.
Connected. It is ready to use.
Pairing failed. Put the controller into pairing mode again and press A.
